name: Turn new blog posts into TikTok and Instagram slideshows with Postdom and Slack approval

parameters.content:
## Turn new blog posts into TikTok and Instagram slideshows

Every new post in your blog's RSS feed becomes a branded slideshow, drawn by Postdom in your own colours, fonts and logo. You approve it in Slack, then Postdom schedules it to your connected TikTok and Instagram accounts.

### How it works
1. **RSS Feed Trigger** checks your feed every hour.
2. **Write slide copy** turns the title and opening sentences into a cover, up to three key-point slides and an end card.
3. **Postdom** renders the slides on your brand kit (`POST /v1/slideshows`).
4. **Slack** sends the preview links and caption with Approve and Decline buttons.
5. On approval, Postdom creates the post for every connected TikTok and Instagram account (`POST /v1/posts`). Your Postdom approval rules still apply.

### Setup
1. In Postdom (https://postdom.com), open **Accounts > Agent keys** and create a key. It starts with `pd_live_`.
2. In n8n, create a **Header Auth** credential: Name `Authorization`, Value `Bearer pd_live_...`. Select it on every Postdom HTTP node.
3. Paste your feed URL into **New blog post**.
4. Connect Slack and pick a channel in both Slack nodes.
5. Adjust **Your settings**: platforms, slide size, handle, TikTok privacy and how many hours after approval to publish.

### Customization tips
- Add an AI step before **Write slide copy** to summarise the post.
- Add `facebook` or `linkedin` to `platforms`.

Docs: https://postdom.com/docs

Read the feed and set your options.
